name: fs_stat
description: Report file bytes, text/binary/unknown classification and exact text line count.

requirements.content:
twylt==1.0.0
pydantic>=2,<3
PyYAML>=6,<7
tomli-w>=1,<2
markdown-it-py>=3,<5
charset-normalizer>=3,<4

path.description: Virtual POSIX path relative to configured workspace root; / is the workspace, not the host root.
path.title: Path

encoding.description: auto recognizes BOM or strict UTF-8; use an explicit codec for other encodings.
encoding.title: Encoding

max_bytes.description: Maximum bytes read for exact classification/line count; larger files return unknown.
max_bytes.title: Max Bytes

size_bytes.description: File size in bytes from filesystem metadata.
size_bytes.title: Size Bytes

content_type.description: Conservative content classification, not MIME type.
content_type.title: Content Type

line_count.description: Exact CR/LF/CRLF line count for fully decoded text; null otherwise.
line_count.title: Line Count

encoding.description: Codec used when content_type=text; null otherwise.
encoding.title: Encoding

encoding_source.description: How encoding was selected for text; auto is a conservative inference, not a certainty.
encoding_source.title: Encoding Source

line_ending.description: Observed newline format; none means no CR/LF; null for non-text.
line_ending.title: Line Ending

indentation.description: Leading spaces/tabs on non-blank lines; mixed across or within lines; null for non-text.
indentation.title: Indentation
